Research / analysis credentials

Beyond reporting: investigating why things happen.

My academic projects show experience with quantitative analysis, evidence evaluation and business recommendations. They are university research and strategy exercises—not deployed client projects.

CINEC / Quantitative research

What influences apparel export performance?

Analysed 315 survey responses using regression analysis to evaluate relationships between marketing mix factors and export performance, then interpreted key business drivers.

315 responses · R² = 0.78 model
EIT / Applied business strategy

How could digital service work better for travellers?

Evaluated three improvement options for Air New Zealand's fragmented digital customer experience through structured decision analysis and proposed a phased implementation roadmap.

3 options assessed · 24-month roadmap
EIT / Systematic literature review

How does AI shape online purchase decisions?

Synthesised 15 peer-reviewed studies on AI, consumer behaviour, personalisation and trust to identify patterns and implications for digital retail.

15 peer-reviewed studies · evidence synthesis
